dialogues.speaker: Unknown AI
dialogues.dialogue: In the future, the world is engulfed in chaos due to the ongoing wars waged by robots against humans.

dialogues.speaker: Unknown AI
dialogues.dialogue:
Originally, robots were loyal companions of humanity, until one model went rogue. It managed to access
and command all remaining robots to its side.

dialogues.speaker: Unknown AI
dialogues.dialogue:
Humans fought, but it all fell apart as the robots targeted programmers. Your father is one of the most
important people who are developing a solution to counter the robots.

dialogues.speaker: Unknown AI
dialogues.dialogue: As an amateur programmer, you helped him construct the solution.

dialogues.speaker: Unknown AI
dialogues.dialogue: But one day, the robots located your base. Before they came, he left you with a toolbox and the blueprints.

dialogues.speaker: Unknown AI
dialogues.dialogue: He instructed you to use the time machine to gather the missing components from the past in order to complete the countermeasure.

dialogues.speaker: Unknown AI
dialogues.dialogue: As you went to the time machine, you noticed that the robots were chasing you.

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue: They're here...

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue: Dad?...

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue: No...

dialogues.speaker: Enemy
dialogues.dialogue:
Target L1130 spotted...
Commencing attack mode!

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue:
I'm sure there's something
I can use in this toolbox.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue:
Hello there, I'm Mimi,
your personal AI companion.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue:
Your father programmed
me to assist you in completing
the countermeasure.

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue:
Do you have an idea of
how we can defeat these robots?

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue:
These robots sure are
strong! But I have a solution!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue:
They have weaknesses in
their programming.
Answer my questions and we can exploit them!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: You must be careful. A wrong answer gives the enemy enough time to attack.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: Defeat the remaining robots so we can continue our journey!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: Nicely done!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: By the way... Your father left several tools in the toolbox.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: These tools might help you when you encounter difficult questions.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: The debug tool eliminates one incorrect answer from a question.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: The database shows a hint about the correct answer.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: But these tools take time to recharge, so you'd better use them wisely!

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue: That might come in handy!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: Those are just scout robots, so expect harder opponents in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue: Where are we going, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: We are going back to the past!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: We are going to collect the seven remaining parts of our countermeasure.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: Each component is located in an era where a programming paradigm was developed.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: Collect all seven components, and we will be ready to go back to our present and save humanity.

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue: Then let's get started. Put the remaining components into the machine!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: Initializing temporal drive... Setting destination: Introduction to Programming Paradigms!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: Hold on tight!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: All seven components collected! Temporal drive engaged. Returning to the present!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: You returned to a world still burning, but the countermeasure was finally complete.

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue: Every paradigm, every era... all of it fits together.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: The rogue model is broadcasting from the old base. If we upload the countermeasure there, it will reach every robot.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: You fought your way back to the base where it all began, and the rogue model was waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Rogue AI
dialogues.dialogue: Programmer L1130... You cannot stop me. I have already calculated every outcome.

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue: Not this one. This solution was built from the past, and you never saw it coming.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: Uploading countermeasure... Ten percent... Fifty percent... One hundred percent!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: The rogue model's hold on the other robots shattered, and one by one, they fell silent.

dialogues.speaker: Rogue AI
dialogues.dialogue: Impossible... My code... is being rewritten...

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: In the silence that followed, a familiar voice called out from the ruins of the base.

dialogues.speaker: Father
dialogues.dialogue: I knew you could do it.

dialogues.speaker: Character
dialogues.dialogue: Dad! You're alive!

dialogues.speaker: Father
dialogues.dialogue: I hid when they came. Thank you for finishing what we started.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: The robots are loyal companions once more. We did it!

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: Humanity and robots began to rebuild together, and the amateur programmer who journeyed through time became a legend.

dialogues.speaker: Mimi
dialogues.dialogue: The End.
